name: react-spring
title: React Spring
responsibility: Physics-based animation for React — springs driven by React state, interrupts, gestures. Interactive transitions where the animation must FOLLOW state, not run alongside it.
reachFor: Interactive components whose motion must track live React state (drag, toggles, sliders)
Natural spring feel where duration-based easing looks mechanical
avoid: Sequenced/entrance choreography — Motion Primitives, anime.js or GSAP timelines are better
One-off hover effects — CSS/motion transitions are lighter
reactWiring: useSpring/useTrail/useTransition + animated.div; springs derive from state changes, cleanup automatic
